title: Governance Decision
description: A concrete decision an organisation, regulator, or governance body made about how AI is governed. This is the hub entity of the workbench: incidents, patterns, controls, evidence and board questions are organised in relation to decisions like this one.

decision_statement.description: The decision itself, stated as a concrete, testable commitment (e.g. 'No AI-based candidate screening tool may be deployed without a documented pre-deployment bias audit').

decision_type.description: The general category of governance action this decision represents.

decision_context.description: What triggered or motivated this decision.

governing_body.description: Who made or owns this decision (e.g. 'Board Risk Committee', 'CISO', 'European Commission').

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictions this decision applies in or was made under (e.g. 'EU', 'US-NY').

frameworks_referenced.description: Names of governance frameworks that informed this decision (e.g. 'NIST AI RMF', 'EU AI Act').

alternatives_considered.description: Other options that were considered and not chosen, for traceability of the decision process.
